result:
I'd make it so people find it easier to understand those they disagree with. Not to agree with them, but to grasp why they believe what they believe, in the way they'd recognize as fair.

A lot of the world's worst conflicts, from family arguments to wars, get worse because each side is working from a caricature of the other. If people could reliably picture the strongest version of an opposing view, many fights would shrink into disagreements about specific facts or values, which are easier to resolve or at least to live with. It would also make people more willing to change their minds, since updating feels less like losing when you're not treating every disagreement as a battle against an enemy.

I'm not sure it's the most important change. Ending poverty or preventable disease would arguably do more good. But those problems are hard partly because people can't agree on how to solve them, so I'd start with the thing that makes the other hard problems harder.

What would you choose?
